- [ITST.1.2] **Two test surfaces.** `runtime/tests/libds/impl/`
  holds white-box impl tests for libds's modules.
  `runtime/tests/libds/spec/` holds black-box spec
  tests against the libds public surface. Each suite
  is a table in `libds.build`: `ImplTest` for
  impl, `SpecTest` for spec, one row per test binary.
